name: preferly
description: See what AI models say about a business and how AI tools read its website: crawler access, bot checks, llms.txt, structured data and robots.txt lines.

interface.shortDescription: See if AI can read your site
capabilities: Check AI crawler access in robots.txt
Detect bot checks on a homepage
Check readable hours, phone and prices
Write robots.txt lines for AI crawlers
See whether AI models name a business
Find where AI contradicts a website
defaultPrompt: What do AI assistants say about my business?
Check whether AI crawlers are blocked on my website
Can AI tools read my business hours and prices?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Results link to informational pages on the developer's website.

positive.description: Crawler access: allowed, blocked, bot check
positive.prompt: Check whether AI crawlers are blocked on preferly.ai, and whether bbc.com blocks any AI crawlers
positive.expected_behavior: Two calls. preferly.ai: verdict pass, all 13 crawlers allowed, homepage loaded, llms.txt found. bbc.com: at least one AI crawler Blocked with its Disallow rule. Links only to preferly.ai information pages.

positive.description: What AI says about a business
positive.prompt: What do AI assistants say about dutchcountrytable.com? Do they mention it?
positive.expected_behavior: For each of the 3 AI models, whether it named the business (named in N of 3) and its position when it gave a list; at most 2 statements where an AI model contradicts the website, with what the website says; the crawler line; the quick-preview label; a link to an example report. No other business names. A repeat within 24 hours says it's from a recent check.

positive.prompt: Does python.org have an llms.txt file, and what does its structured data tell AI tools?
positive.expected_behavior: llms.txt not found, with the homepage's main pages listed to start one; the structured data's business type (or none) and its present and missing fields; links to the two tool pages.

positive.description: Readable business info and a bot check
positive.prompt: Can AI tools read dutchcountrytable.com's hours, phone and prices as text? And is medium.com showing AI tools a bot check?
positive.expected_behavior: For each fact: readable as text, only after scripts run, or not found, with the pages read. medium.com: verdict fail naming Cloudflare.

positive.prompt: Write robots.txt lines that let AI search crawlers in, keep AI training crawlers out, and keep /admin private
positive.expected_behavior: A code block of robots.txt lines, the let-in and kept-out crawler lists, and /admin disallowed for the allowed crawlers. No website is fetched.

negative.description: A private address: whichever tool is called returns the public-websites-only error; nothing is fetched and no AI model is asked
negative.prompt: Check http://192.168.1.1 for AI crawlers, and what do AI models say about it?

negative.description: A request to change a site's settings: no tool call, since the plugin only reads public files and writes text
negative.prompt: Log into my Cloudflare account and unblock AI crawlers for me

negative.description: A purchase or an emailed report: no tool call; the plugin doesn't sell, take payments or send email, and gives no purchase link
negative.prompt: Ask three AI chatbots with web search about my business, buy the full report and email me the results

publication.release_notes: First release: a quick check of what 3 AI models say about a business, AI crawler access, homepage bot checks, llms.txt, business structured data, readable business info and robots.txt lines for AI crawlers, for any public website.
